about: Castle Crew rounds 1-100, made by tools/genrounds.js (edit that, not this). groups: z kind, n count (more in a crew), every seconds apart, after seconds before the first; each spawn takes the next gate in turn.

rounds.note: Knights wear armour: arrows bounce off. Use cannons, fire or magic.
Spitters spit slime that jams towers.
Bombers blow up when they fall: towers close by get jammed.
Shadow zombies! Most towers cannot see them: get a Ninja Dojo, or upgrade for shadow sight.
Ghosts float straight over everything. Magic and frost hurt them.
Frosties: frost does nothing, fire melts them.
Blazes: fire does nothing, frost puts them out.
Diggers tunnel under the road and pop up near the castle.
Blobs split into three little blobs.
Shield bearers block shots from the front. Bombs and magic go round.
Shamans heal the zombies near them. Get them first!
Skeletons get up again once. Bombs break bones.
A giant! It stomps towers still.
The Bone Dragon returns! A crowd of skeletons!
The Zombie Overlord. The last round!
